findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design_review, upload_asset, compose_surface, get_scene, list_assets, publish_scene · Private data: probe_lighting, upload_asset, apply_ops · Public sink: list_scenes, probe_framing, upload_asset, compose_surface, get_scene, create_scene, list_assets, get_scene_screenshot, publish_scene · Destructive: apply_ops.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design_review, upload_asset, compose_surface, get_scene, list_assets, publish_scene · Private data: probe_lighting, upload_asset, apply_ops · Public sink: list_scenes, probe_framing, upload_asset, compose_surface, get_scene, create_scene, list_assets, get_scene_screenshot, publish_scene · Destructive: apply_ops

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
